note: Set A is significantly better as it accurately extracts document metadata (copyright, lot number, revisions) which Set B ignores. Set B contains numerous misbinding errors, attributing components to the wrong details (e.g., claiming C5 has 11"x3/8" plates when it has 5"x3/8", assigning C1 members to C5, and assigning C5 plates to Module Link). Set A has a few detail binding errors (attributing C1/D1 members to C5) and one thickness contradiction, but is far more faithful to the source text and image associations overall.
